description: <attemptDir>/supervisor-binding.json. Published once by the supervisor after the gate is running inside the containment domain and before GO is sent. Its presence means the attempt was handed over: the controller closes its lock fds when it sees it.

fields.bootId: string, /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id on Linux; platform boot identifier elsewhere
fields.pidNs: string, pid namespace inode as seen from the host (Linux), empty string elsewhere
fields.pid: integer, pid as seen from the host
fields.startTime: string, process start time in the platform's native units

fields.attemptId: string, equal to the envelope's attemptId
fields.envelopeDigest: string, equal to the envelope's digest
fields.gate: processTuple of the gate as seen from the host (linux-gate: the child pid bwrap reports on --info-fd, i.e. pid 1 of the attempt namespace)
fields.agent: processTuple or absent; published later only by the gate's AGENT frame through the supervisor log, never by rewriting this file

domain.id: domain id exactly as containment.create returned it and as the supervisor declared it into <attemptDir>/attempt.lock.predecessor.json (predecessor.v1.json domainId)

invariants: published after declare_domain and spawn_in succeeded, before GO
never rewritten; a second supervisor for the same attempt cannot exist because it would need the attempt lock description
absent binding after the controller's wait is launch-unknown, never not-started
